password_changed.subject: Password changed
password_changed.text: The password of your Taranis NG account was changed.

password_removed.subject: Password sign-in turned off
password_removed.text: The password of your Taranis NG account was removed, so you can no longer sign in with a password. Use the other sign-in methods set up for your account.

totp_enabled.subject: Two-factor authentication turned on
totp_enabled.text: An authenticator app (TOTP) was set up as a second factor for your Taranis NG account.

totp_disabled.subject: Two-factor authentication turned off
totp_disabled.text: The authenticator app (TOTP) was removed from your Taranis NG account. Signing in no longer asks for its one-time code.

passkey_added.subject: New passkey added
passkey_added.text: A new passkey was registered for your Taranis NG account.

passkey_removed.subject: Passkey removed
passkey_removed.text: A passkey was removed from your Taranis NG account.

mfa_reset.subject: Your second factors were reset
mfa_reset.text: An administrator reset the second factors of your Taranis NG account. You may be asked to set them up again the next time you sign in.

test.subject: Test e-mail
test.text: This is a test e-mail from Taranis NG. If you are reading it, the e-mail settings work.

unexpected: If you did not make this change, contact your administrator immediately.
signature: This is an automated message from Taranis NG.
signature_with_url: This is an automated message from Taranis NG ({url}).
